title: Psalm 11
opening_line: I in the LORD do put my trust:

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: I in the LORD do put my trust:
text.normalized: I in the LORD do put my trust:
text.reading: I in the LORD do put my trust:

text.diplomatic: how is it then that ye
text.normalized: How is it then that ye
text.reading: how is it then that ye

text.diplomatic: Say to my soul, Flee, as a bird,
text.normalized: Say to my soul, Flee, as a bird,
text.reading: Say to my soul, Flee, as a bird,

text.diplomatic: unto your mountain high?
text.normalized: Unto your mountain high?
text.reading: unto your mountain high?

text.diplomatic: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow,
text.normalized: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow,
text.reading: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow,

text.diplomatic: their shafts on string they fit,
text.normalized: Their shafts on string they fit,
text.reading: their shafts on string they fit,

text.diplomatic: That those who upright are in heart
text.normalized: That those who upright are in heart
text.reading: That those who upright are in heart

text.diplomatic: they privily may hit.
text.normalized: They privily may hit.
text.reading: they privily may hit.

text.diplomatic: If the foundations be destroyed,
text.normalized: If the foundations be destroyed,
text.reading: If the foundations be destroyed,

text.diplomatic: what hath the righteous done?
text.normalized: What hath the righteous done?
text.reading: what hath the righteous done?

text.diplomatic: GOD in his holy temple is,
text.normalized: GOD in his holy temple is,
text.reading: GOD in his holy temple is,

text.diplomatic: in heaven is his throne:
text.normalized: In heaven is his throne:
text.reading: in heaven is his throne:

text.diplomatic: His eyes do see, his eyelids try
text.normalized: His eyes do see, his eyelids try
text.reading: His eyes do see, his eyelids try

text.diplomatic: men’s sons. The just he proves:
text.normalized: Men’s sons. The just he proves:
text.reading: men’s sons. The just he proves:

text.diplomatic: But his soul hates the wicked man,
text.normalized: But his soul hates the wicked man,
text.reading: But his soul hates the wicked man,

text.diplomatic: and him that vi’lence loves.
text.normalized: And him that vi’lence loves.
text.reading: and him that vi’lence loves.

text.diplomatic: Snares, fire and brimstone, furious storms,
text.normalized: Snares, fire and brimstone, furious storms,
text.reading: Snares, fire and brimstone, furious storms,

text.diplomatic: on sinners he shall rain:
text.normalized: On sinners he shall rain:
text.reading: on sinners he shall rain:

text.diplomatic: This, as the portion of their cup,
text.normalized: This, as the portion of their cup,
text.reading: This, as the portion of their cup,

text.diplomatic: doth unto them pertain.
text.normalized: Doth unto them pertain.
text.reading: doth unto them pertain.

text.diplomatic: Because the LORD most righteous doth
text.normalized: Because the LORD most righteous doth
text.reading: Because the LORD most righteous doth

text.diplomatic: in righteousness delight;
text.normalized: In righteousness delight;
text.reading: in righteousness delight;

text.diplomatic: And with a pleasant countenance
text.normalized: And with a pleasant countenance
text.reading: And with a pleasant countenance

text.diplomatic: beholdeth the upright.
text.normalized: Beholdeth the upright.
text.reading: beholdeth the upright.
